en: Changed `/ultrareview` on macOS and Linux to require git 2.31 or newer to upload a local repository; checkouts made with `--separate-git-dir` are now refused instead of being uploaded with an older method
zh: 变更 macOS 和 Linux 上的 `/ultrareview`：上传本地仓库现在要求 git 2.31 或更高版本；使用 `--separate-git-dir` 创建的检出现在会被拒绝，而不再用旧方法上传
